headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Airthings Wave / Corentium devices over Bluetooth LE. Protocol based on the [official Airthings BLE library](https://github.com/Airthings/airthings-ble).
footerDisplay: Requires BlueZ and a working Bluetooth adapter. On Raspberry Pi, run Homebridge as a user in the `bluetooth` group. Radon is exposed via custom characteristics and mapped to HomeKit Air Quality.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: How often to connect and poll each device (min 5 minutes). Longer intervals reduce battery use.

scanDuration.title: Scan duration (seconds)
scanDuration.description: How long to scan for Airthings devices at startup.

isMetric.title: Metric units for radon
isMetric.description: When true, radon is reported in Bq/m³. When false, pCi/L.

co2AlertThreshold.title: CO₂ alert threshold (ppm)
co2AlertThreshold.description: HomeKit Carbon Dioxide Detected is abnormal when CO₂ is at or above this level. Devices do not expose a threshold over BLE.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Optional. Restrict to these devices by serial number or Bluetooth address. Leave empty to auto-discover all nearby Airthings sensors.

serialNumber.title: Serial number
serialNumber.description: Airthings serial number from manufacturer data (digits).

address.title: Bluetooth address
address.description: MAC address (Linux) or UUID (macOS), e.g. aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff.
